---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: ""
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case
Explain the problem this feature would solve. Who would benefit? How would they use it?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this working. Include:
- Command-line interface changes
- Agent configuration changes
- New files or modifications needed

## Alternatives Considered
What other approaches did you consider? Why is this the best option?

## Supported Agents Affected
Which agents would this apply to?
- [ ] OpenCode
- [ ] Claude Code
- [ ] GitHub Copilot (VS Code)
- [ ] Cursor
- [ ] Windsurf
- [ ] OpenAI Codex
- [ ] Continue
- [ ] Cline
- [ ] JetBrains AI
- [ ] Amazon Q Developer
- [ ] Warp
- [ ] Universal Shell (fast-download.sh)
- [ ] PowerShell Module (FastDownload.psm1)

## Additional Context
Mockups, examples, related issues, or links to similar implementations.
